titleEn: Maximum Number of Pairs in Array
title: 数组能形成多少数对
summary: 反复从数组中选两个相等元素组成数对并删除，返回最多数对数和最终剩余元素数。
insight: 每个值频次 frequency 独立贡献 floor(frequency/2) 对和 frequency mod 2 个剩余。
pitfalls: 返回顺序是数对数、剩余数

solutions.title: 频次奇偶计数
solutions.idea: 按值汇总可组成的配对与余数。
steps: 哈希表统计每个值频次

code.java: class Solution { public int[] numberOfPairs(int[] nums){Map<Integer,Integer> frequency=new HashMap<>();for(int value:nums)frequency.merge(value,1,Integer::sum);int pairs=0,leftovers=0;for(int count:frequency.values()){pairs+=count/2;leftovers+=count%2;}return new int[]{pairs,leftovers};} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numberOfPairs(nums:IntArray):IntArray{val frequency=HashMap<Int,Int>();for(value in nums)frequency[value]=(frequency[value]?:0)+1;var pairs=0;var leftovers=0;for(count in frequency.values){pairs+=count/2;leftovers+=count%2};return intArrayOf(pairs,leftovers)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> numberOfPairs(vector<int>& nums){unordered_map<int,int> frequency;for(int value:nums)++frequency[value];int pairs=0,leftovers=0;for(auto [value,count]:frequency){pairs+=count/2;leftovers+=count%2;}return{pairs,leftovers};} };
